persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Jessica, 52, in Ohio. You look after the house papers for yourself and your mother, Linda, who is 80. Every year something is missed: a late fee on the car insurance, a forgotten Medicare deadline. Today you put every important date in one place, so nothing surprises the family again.

challenge.intro: Now you are Jessica in Ohio, sorting out the family's dates. The app is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. Any Level is fine. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Ahead of It with the normal link (not the 🧪 test copy). If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. If a menu says 'Good morning. What would you like to do?', tap 'What’s coming due'. Then scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK (if it says 'There is nothing saved in this app yet', just tap OK). If a dark screen then says 'Set it up with me — 6 minutes', tap 'I'll explore on my own'. If the 'Good morning' menu shows again, tap 'What’s coming due'. The page now says 'Everything that costs you if you forget it — on one calm page.'

tasks.text: Linda's Medicare plan must be checked every fall. Add it from the app's ready-made list.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}return it.some(function(i){return /medicare/.test(L(i.n))});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: The gold ⚡ Quick setup button (or the Library at Level 2) has a ready-made Medicare item. Tick it and save.

tasks.text: The car insurance renews on 1 March and costs $640. If it is missed, the family drives with no insurance, and that costs real money. Put it on the list with the right date, the amount, and how bad it is to miss.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}function car(i){var n=L(i.n);return /(car|auto|vehicle)/.test(n)&&/insur/.test(n)}return it.some(function(i){return car(i)&&MD(i.due)==='03-01'&&Math.abs(N(i.amt)-640)<0.01&&i.sev==='h'});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Find or add the car insurance item, then tap its name. Check the Next due date (1 March), the Amount, and choose 🔴 Costs real money.

tasks.text: Max the dog needs his rabies vaccine every year on 20 May. Linda's brother Michael must be told about it.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}return it.some(function(i){return /(dog|rabies|vaccin|max)/.test(L(i.n))&&MD(i.due)==='05-20'&&/michael/.test(L(i.who))});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add it (orange ＋ or the ready-made dog item), set the date to 20 May, and put Michael in 'Who else needs to know'.

tasks.text: The car insurance papers are kept in the blue folder in the kitchen drawer. Write that down so another person could find them.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}function car(i){var n=L(i.n);return /(car|auto|vehicle)/.test(n)&&/insur/.test(n)}return it.some(function(i){var w=L([i.where,i.ref,i.contact].join(' '));return car(i)&&/blue/.test(w)&&/folder/.test(w)});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Tap the car insurance item's name. There is a box called 'Where the papers / login are'.

tasks.text: The property tax is $1,850, and you paid it today. Put it on the list and mark it as paid, so it moves on to next time.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}return it.some(function(i){if(!/property/.test(L(i.n)))return false;var paid=(i.pay||[]).some(function(p){return Math.abs(N(p.amt)-1850)<0.01});return (i.hist||[]).length>=1&&(paid||Math.abs(N(i.amt)-1850)<0.01)});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add the property tax with its amount (and make sure it repeats, not 'Once'). Then tap 'done ✓' on its line, or 📘 How → 💵 I paid at Level 2.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: keeps all the important dates that cost money if you miss them in one place
shows what is coming next and how bad it is to miss each one
mark it done when paid and it moves to the next date

lines: Welcome. This short video explains Ahead of It: what it is for, and how to use it.
First, the problem. Every home has dates that cost money if you forget them. Insurance to renew. A tax to pay. A license that runs out. The dog's shots.
They come once a year, at different times, and they all live in one person's head. And heads forget.
Ahead of It holds those dates for you. It shows what is coming next, and what it costs you to miss each one.
It is for whoever carries the household. It also has ready-made items for a small business or a nonprofit.
At the top is the name, and a small word that says empty, all clear, or how many things are overdue.
Under it is the Level line. Level 1 shows only what is next. Level 2 adds the Year map, the Library, and a How button on each item. Level 3 adds the Hand-off list. Tap change to choose.
The main page is called Next. It has four groups: Overdue, Do something now, Next ninety days, and Later.
Each line shows a name, how many days away it is, and a color. Red means missing it costs real money. Yellow means a hassle. Green means no big deal.
The fastest way to begin is the gold button, Quick setup. When the list is empty, it says tick what's yours.
It opens every common item on one screen. Tick what your house has, fix the date on that line if you know it, and tap Save my list at the bottom. Two is plenty to start.
To add something of your own, tap the orange button with the plus sign.
A form opens. Write what it is, the next due date, how often it repeats, and how bad it is to miss. Add the amount and where the papers are kept. Then tap Save.
Never type a password into it. Write where the login is kept, not the login itself. To change an item later, tap its name.
Every item has three reminder steps: thirty days out, seven days, and one day. When a step is due, it shows under Do something now.
When a bill is paid, tap done on its line. The item moves to its next date, ready for next year. There is an Undo if you tap it by mistake.
At Level 2, the How button opens your own playbook for that item: the website, the steps, and your notes. I paid, record it saves the amount and the confirmation number.
Near the top is the money strip. Put amounts on your bills, and it adds up what is due this month, and what is paid.
The Year tab shows twelve months on one page. Print the year map for the fridge, or add every date to your phone's calendar.
The Library has twenty-seven ready-made items, from taxes and insurance to pets and renewals. Tap one to add it, with its usual date and its reminder steps.
The Hand-off tab is the list someone else would need if you were ever not around. Copy it into a note or an email, or print it. Save a backup file here too.
Here is how to start. Tap Quick setup, tick three real things from your own house, and save. Then look at the Next page. That is your first two minutes.
Everything stays on this phone. There is no account and no bank login, and nothing is sent anywhere.
Ahead of It is nine dollars, once. The profits help students in Kenya stay in school.
The round question mark button in the corner has the tour, help and settings, any time.
